name: GT2 smooth idler, 5 mm bore (generic)
summary: 5 mm bore, 18 mm flanges and an 8 mm belt channel.
source: Generic flanged idler for a 6 mm-wide GT2 belt. Chosen flange diameter 18 mm, overall width 10 mm, two 1 mm lips and 5 mm through bore. No common standard fixes these envelopes; measure the bought idler. Bearings and bearing shields are visual simplifications.
